caption:
Every part of the Ghost, spinning, before any of it hits the printer.

8 shell pieces, each designed to ride a spring-loaded pin. 8 tendons meet at the spider ring, and a servo winds the spool to pull the shell shut. Pan and tilt servos live in the base.

Estimated $165 in parts. The generator is parametric, so every dimension is a number you can change, and it checks the parts for collisions before it writes the STLs.

Files are free, link in bio. Printing starts soon.

Fan project. Destiny and the Ghost belong to Bungie.
